_readme: Rate profiles for the tokenomics tools. The course is price-agnostic:
these values are data that you look up and record, not facts the code knows.
Before you record a cost, check each value on the vendor price list and update 'checked'.
Form 1, per_mtok: price per million tokens for each meter, in 'unit' (for example USD).
Form 2, multipliers: rate relative to the input rate. Cost is then in input-equivalent tokens.
Every profile needs all five meters: input, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, cache_read, output.
Profile names are the model IDs that Claude Code and the API report, so later tools can match them.
Optional long_prompt: {over_tokens, profile}. A request with a longer prompt (input + cache writes + cache reads) uses that profile.
cache_write_5m is the short cache lifetime and cache_write_1h is the long one. For OpenAI, they hold the 30-minute (default) and 12-hour write rates.
OpenAI: the API profiles are in USD. The 'codex-credits/<model>' profiles are Codex credits at Standard speed (Fast mode costs more; see the source).

relative.source: Lesson 1.2: the shape of an Anthropic bill
relative.note: No prices. Shows where the cost goes, in input-equivalent tokens.

claude-fable-5-2.note: Large tier, top of the line. Cache reads are 0.025x input.

claude-opus-5-5.note: Large tier. The Claude Code default. Cache reads are 0.05x input.

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Workhorse tier. Cache reads are 0.05x input.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: Small tier. For prompts of 100,000 tokens or fewer. A longer prompt uses claude-haiku-5-5-over-100k.

claude-haiku-5-5-over-100k.note: Small tier, prompts over 100,000 tokens (cache reads and writes count toward the prompt). 5x the short-prompt rates.

gpt-6-astra.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier. Large tier. Cache reads are 0.1x input. For prompts of 272,000 tokens or fewer.

gpt-6-astra-over-272k.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier, prompts over 272,000 tokens.

gpt-6.1-sol.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier. Workhorse tier, the Codex default. Cache reads are 0.05x input. For prompts of 272,000 tokens or fewer.

gpt-6.1-sol-over-272k.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier, prompts over 272,000 tokens.

gpt-6.1-terra.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier. Balanced tier. Cache reads are 0.05x input. For prompts of 272,000 tokens or fewer.

gpt-6.1-terra-over-272k.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier, prompts over 272,000 tokens.

gpt-6-luna.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier. Small tier. Cache reads are 0.1x input. For prompts of 272,000 tokens or fewer.

gpt-6-luna-over-272k.note: OpenAI API, Standard tier, prompts over 272,000 tokens.

codex-credits/gpt-6-astra.note: Codex credits, Standard speed. No separate cache-write charge: cache writes use the input rate.

codex-credits/gpt-6.1-sol.note: Codex credits, Standard speed. No separate cache-write charge: cache writes use the input rate.

codex-credits/gpt-6.1-terra.note: Codex credits, Standard speed. No separate cache-write charge: cache writes use the input rate.

codex-credits/gpt-6-luna.note: Codex credits, Standard speed. No separate cache-write charge: cache writes use the input rate.
